articles.excerpt: Introduction Watching television over the internet has become increasingly common. However, a smooth streaming experience depends on several technical factors working together. Even when a device and…
articles.body: Introduction Watching television over the internet has become increasingly common. However, a smooth streaming experience depends on several technical factors working together. Even when a device and streaming application are compatible, viewers may still experience buffering, reduced video quality, or unexpected playback interruptions. Understanding the reasons behind these problems can help users troubleshoot their connections and make better decisions about their home network. In this article, we will explore the main factors affecting IPTV streaming quality and discuss practical ways to improve playback performance. 1. Understanding What Affects Streaming Quality Streaming quality is not determined by internet speed alone.
articles.author: IPTV Portugal

articles.title: Integrating cross-chain swaps without custody: a deposit-address API walkthrough
articles.excerpt: Most swap integrations force a custody decision on you before you write a line of code. Aggregator routers need your users to connect a wallet and sign contract calls. Custodial APIs need you to hold…
articles.body: Most swap integrations force a custody decision on you before you write a line of code. Aggregator routers need your users to connect a wallet and sign contract calls. Custodial APIs need you to hold balances. There is a third shape, and it is the one exchanges have quietly used for years: the deposit-address flow . Your app shows the user a one-time deposit address, watches for the incoming transfer, and the service delivers the swapped asset to an address your user controls. No wallet connection, no contract approvals, no pooled funds in your name. This walkthrough shows how that flow works against a live service — AllSwap , a non-custodial cross-chain swap service — using its public API. Everything below is based on the production endpoints; the full reference is in the API docs .
articles.author: Arnold Tsing

articles.title: Day 16/90: Build a Bounded Agent Loop — How Do You Stop an AI Agent from Running Forever?
articles.excerpt: An AI agent can select the right tool, receive a result, and still fail to complete its task. It might call the same tool repeatedly, retry an operation that keeps failing, or continue reasoning witho…
articles.body: An AI agent can select the right tool, receive a result, and still fail to complete its task. It might call the same tool repeatedly, retry an operation that keeps failing, or continue reasoning without making meaningful progress. The problem isn't always the model's intelligence. Sometimes the application has no reliable stopping boundary. For Day 16 of my AI engineering journey, I'm exploring bounded agent loops : how to control agent execution, define stopping conditions, and evaluate what happens when an agent reaches its execution limit. What is an agent loop? An agent loop is a repeated execution cycle in which an AI model: Receives the current task and context. Decides what to do next. Calls a tool or produces a response. Observes the result.
articles.author: Rimsha Kanwal

articles.title: 블랙록 BUIDL: 토큰화 펀드의 진짜 모습 들여다보기
articles.excerpt: 블랙록의 BUIDL 펀드가 이더리움 블록체인에서 출범했다는 소식은 단순히 헤드라인 하나를 장식한 사건에 그치지 않는다. 지난 수십 년간 이 분야를 지켜본 이들에게는 하나의 명확한 청사진으로 다가왔다. 오랜 시간 동안 '토큰화'는 분할 소유권과 즉각적인 유동성에 대한 막연한 약속을 동반하는 그저 유행어에 불과했다. 그러나 10조 달러가 넘는 자산을 운용하는…
articles.body: 블랙록의 BUIDL 펀드가 이더리움 블록체인에서 출범했다는 소식은 단순히 헤드라인 하나를 장식한 사건에 그치지 않는다. 지난 수십 년간 이 분야를 지켜본 이들에게는 하나의 명확한 청사진으로 다가왔다. 오랜 시간 동안 '토큰화'는 분할 소유권과 즉각적인 유동성에 대한 막연한 약속을 동반하는 그저 유행어에 불과했다. 그러나 10조 달러가 넘는 자산을 운용하는 블랙록 같은 거물이 발을 들여놓자, 이론은 현실이 된다. BUIDL이 우리에게 보여준 것은 급진적이고 허가 없는 혁명이 아니라, 현존하는 금융 프레임워크 내에서 규제 준수와 운영 효율성을 최우선으로 하는, 블록체인 기술의 실용적이고 기관 등급의 적용 사례다. 이는 오늘날 토큰화 펀드의 실제 구조를 명확히 보여주는 듯하다. 내 관점은 이렇다. 기관 토큰화의 초기 단계는 완전한 탈중앙화나 개방형 접근 모델을 즉각적으로 추진하기보다, 기존 금융 시스템 안에서 규제 준수와 운영 효율성을 우선시한다는 것이다. 만약 향후 18~24개월 안에 규제 진화 없이 이러한 펀드에 대한 진정한 허가 없는 보조 시장으로 빠르게 전환된다면, 이러한 신중하고 구조화된 접근 방식에 대한 나의 해석은 틀릴 수도 있다. 하지만 그렇게 될 것이라고는 생각하지 않는다. 배경 블랙록의 BUIDL, 공식 명칭으로는 'BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund'의 세부 사항을 처음 파고들었을 때, 그 의도적인 설계에 깊은 인상을 받았다. 이는 단순히 자산에 디지털 옷을 입히는 것을 넘어선다.
articles.author: Record0x

articles.title: BlackRock BUIDL: Unpacking the Actual Structure of Tokenized Funds
articles.excerpt: TITLE: BlackRock BUIDL: Unpacking the Actual Structure of Tokenized Funds The launch of BlackRock's BUIDL fund on the Ethereum blockchain wasn't just another headline; it was, for those of us who have…
articles.body: TITLE: BlackRock BUIDL: Unpacking the Actual Structure of Tokenized Funds The launch of BlackRock's BUIDL fund on the Ethereum blockchain wasn't just another headline; it was, for those of us who have watched this space for decades, a tangible blueprint. For too long, "tokenization" has been a buzzword, often accompanied by vague promises of fractional ownership and instant liquidity. But when a titan like BlackRock, overseeing assets north of $10 trillion, steps in, the theoretical gives way to the practical. What BUIDL has shown us isn't a radical, permissionless revolution, but rather a pragmatic, institutional-grade application of blockchain technology that clarifies the actual structure of tokenized funds today.
articles.author: Record0x

Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space. articles.excerpt: If you're looking to become a Dungeon Master, Matthew Mercer's advice is all you need.
articles.body: Matthew Mercer is one of the world's most popular Dungeon Masters. Alongside other incredible DMs like Deborah Ann Woll, Brennan Lee Mulligan, and Aabria Iyengar, Mercer has undeniably shaped how players worldwide approach tabletop role-playing games. As Critical Role , the multimedia entertainment company Mercer co-founded, has grown and evolved over the years, one thing has remained constant: Mercer’s willingness to help other tabletop players. He is especially eager to support aspiring Dungeon Masters who hope to develop their skills and become as accomplished as he is, even appearing on the official Dungeons & Dragons YouTube page to provide assistance.

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.excerpt: By modeling how a planet without life develops its atmosphere, astronomers hope to be able to better distinguish rocky planets without life from those that are inhabited.
articles.body: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.
articles.author: Keith Cooper

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 7, 1992: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor, its 1st Mars mission in 20 years at the time, to map the Red Planet like never before
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission, the first Mars mission in 20 years. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission. This was the first mission NASA sent to Mars in almost 20 years! The Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft was an orbiter. It transmitted data from NASA's Mars rovers Sojourner , Spirit and Opportunity back to Earth. The spacecraft also did a lot of its own science. It found surface channels on Mars that appeared to have been created by running water. Mars Global Surveyor looked at the south pole of Mars and saw signs of possible climate change. It also saw a mineral called hematite on Mars. Hematite usually forms in water. NASA then sent its Spirit and Opportunity rovers to look for the hematite, and both rovers found it near their landing sites. Mars Global Surveyor survived much longer than expected.

articles.title: Send your name to Saturn's moon Titan with NASA's upcoming Dragonfly mission
articles.excerpt: NASA is asking the public to send their names to Titan for an ambitious mission that will see a flying craft explore the Saturn moon in 2034, if all goes according to plan.
articles.body: We still may be some time away from sending humans to distant reaches of the solar system, but you can send your name to Saturn's moon Titan, which has the ingredients of life on its surface thanks to NASA's Dragonfly mission. Dragonfly is an SUV-sized nuclear-powered rotorcraft that NASA aims to launch towards Titan in 2028. The agency opened a special events page in late October to allow members of the public to put their name on the spacecraft. The names will be put upon a chip on Dragonfly during the spacecraft's assembly, and all names must be submitted before Jan. 15, 2027. The agency says that the mission has no "ordinary itinerary," as Dragonfly aims to between areas miles (or kilometers) apart after arriving on the surface in 2034.

articles.title: Star Wars is experiencing a golden age of video games
articles.excerpt: The movies might be struggling to recapture the magic, but Star Wars video games are strong with the Force.
articles.body: After a tumultuous start to EA's rebooted Star Wars Battlefront series, in 2021 Lucasfilm and Disney decided to open up the development of new Star Wars games by bringing in different publishers and studios under the Lucasfilm Games banner. Now, over five years on, we can confidently say we're entering a new golden era of amazing Star Wars games . With LucasArts' successor calling the shots and coordinating a multitude of projects set in a galaxy far, far away, even EA's latest efforts like Squadrons and the Jedi series have taken bigger and bolder swings. Now, in 2026, the full potential of the Star Wars universe has become clearer with specific releases squarely aimed at niche audiences.
